cases.charge_summary: Constructing an unauthorized 15-liter ethanol distillation apparatus inside the Sub-Level 2 ventilation return riser, utilizing hospital copper tubing and radiator steam.
cases.evidence_presented: One modified tea urn, six meters of silver-soldered copper coil, 20 liters of fermented potato peel mash, and a strong aroma of toasted bread and pear drops in Corridor C.
cases.verdict_outcome: Guilty with Mitigating Engineering Merit
cases.disciplinary_penalty: Apparatus confiscated for medical disinfectant production. Defendant sentenced to 40 hours cleaning boiler flue soot without beer ration.
cases.clerk_margin_notes: Dmitri noted the solder joints were immaculate. He confiscated five liters for 'hydraulic valve cleaning' before the evidence was locked in stores.

cases.charge_summary: Forgery of official Dwellers' Council potato-stamped laundry exemption tokens and trading them for tobacco and canned sardines.
cases.evidence_presented: One carved turnip stamp with the Council seal, an inkpad made of lamp black and pork lard, and 34 counterfeit laundry tokens found under a mattress.
cases.verdict_outcome: Guilty of Commercial Deception
cases.disciplinary_penalty: Defendants assigned to scrub the entire Sub-Level 3 communal laundry facility by hand with lye soap for fourteen consecutive days.
cases.clerk_margin_notes: Oxana caught them when Valery tried to pay for a third bowl of cabbage stew with a token that smelled strongly of raw turnip.

cases.charge_summary: Playing loud syncopated sea shanties and waltzes on the bayan accordion in the machine shop at 02:30, violating the Mandatory Silence Order during surface seismic tremors.
cases.evidence_presented: One 120-bass Tula accordion, two empty bottles of turnip kvass, and written complaints from sixteen exhausted dwellers in Cubicle Block B.
cases.verdict_outcome: Guilty of Acoustic Nuisance / Remanded with Reprimand
cases.disciplinary_penalty: Accordion impounded between 21:00 and 07:00. Defendants ordered to perform an official Sunday evening concert in the canteen to restore harmony.
cases.clerk_margin_notes: Stepan admitted under questioning that he tapped his rifle stock to the rhythm for twenty minutes before remembering he was on sentry duty.

cases.charge_summary: Concealing an unregistered biological organism (one three-legged calico kitten) in the Hydroponic Greenhouse, feeding it surplus milk ration.
cases.evidence_presented: One calico kitten asleep inside a hollowed cabbage head, four dead sewer mice placed proudly on Elena's desk, and two chewed electrical cords.
cases.verdict_outcome: Acquitted / Creature Officially Naturalized as Vault Pest Control Officer
cases.disciplinary_penalty: No penalty. Kitten designated 'Chief Rodent Interceptor Masha' with official ration chit of two ounces boiled fish scrap daily.
cases.clerk_margin_notes: Dr. Vel attempted to look stern, but was observed scratching the cat behind its left ear while reading the verdict. The entire room cheered.

cases.charge_summary: Systematic preferential ladling from the bottom of the borscht kettle (dense meat chunks) for Machine Shop workers while serving surface sentries thin broth.
cases.evidence_presented: Volumetric sediment analysis of soup bowls presented by Stepan showing 45g meat solids in Oleg's bowl versus 8g in Stepan's bowl.
cases.verdict_outcome: Guilty of Caloric Inequity
cases.disciplinary_penalty: Kitchen ladle modified with standardized volume perforated baffle. Oxana sentenced to bake twenty dozen sweet apple fritters for the sentry watch.
cases.clerk_margin_notes: Oxana argued that 'metalworkers burn 4,000 calories while sentries just stand there wrapped in blankets.' The tribunal ordered mathematical equality.

cases.presiding_magistrate: Chief Engineer Dmitri & Dr. Irina Vel
cases.charge_summary: Soldering unauthorized 30-meter wire antennas to the main periscope mast to eavesdrop on distant foreign jazz broadcasts, risking lightning strike grounding.
cases.evidence_presented: Two spools of high-tension telephone wire, four porcelain insulators, and recorded cassette tapes of New Orleans big band jazz and weather loops.
cases.verdict_outcome: Guilty of Structural Recklessness / Commended for Signal Intelligence
cases.disciplinary_penalty: Antenna refitted with spark-gap lightning arrestors under Dmitri's supervision. Defendant required to log all intercept frequencies for public ledger.
cases.clerk_margin_notes: Taras played the tape of 'St. Louis Blues' to the magistrates. Dr. Vel tapped her fountain pen against her glass. Case dismissed with technical upgrades.

cases.charge_summary: Theft of twelve tallow emergency candles from the Deep Substation cache to boil down for boot leather waterproofing wax.
cases.evidence_presented: Six pairs of exceptionally shiny, waterproofed winter boots and a lingering smell of fried fat in Yuri's cobbling alcove.
cases.verdict_outcome: Guilty of Resource Divergence
cases.disciplinary_penalty: Defendant required to waterproof thirty pairs of sentry winter boots for free, utilizing vegetable tannin liquor instead of emergency candles.
cases.clerk_margin_notes: Harlan admitted the boots were the best he had ever worn in forty below weather. The Council ruled that survival utility mitigated the crime.

cases.charge_summary: Writing subversive chalk slogans on the Corridor C concrete wall reading: 'MORE SUGAR IN THE TEA, LESS SPEECHES ON THE INTERCOM!'
cases.evidence_presented: Blue chalk dust found on Valery's cuffs matching the schoolhouse supply; handwriting analysis of letter 'E'.
cases.verdict_outcome: Guilty of Public Defacement and Seditious Whining
cases.disciplinary_penalty: Defendant ordered to whitewash 100 meters of corridor wall with slaked lime and memorize the 1981 Civil Defense Rationing Charter.
cases.clerk_margin_notes: Anna admitted the tea was indeed weak, but maintained that chalking it on the walls caused panic. Sugar ration was reviewed the following week.

cases.presiding_magistrate: Chief Engineer Dmitri & Dr. Irina Vel
cases.charge_summary: Picking the brass padlock on the Artesian Well reservoir manifold at 03:00 to fill a 40-liter galvanized tub for an unauthorized private hot bath.
cases.evidence_presented: One bent steel hairclip, one hot galvanized wash tub, and a 40-liter deficit in the daily reservoir pressure chart.
cases.verdict_outcome: Guilty of Critical Utility Tampering (Class A Infraction)
cases.disciplinary_penalty: Defendant assigned to manual pump duty on the Sub-Level 4 drainage sump for thirty days (4 hours daily before morning shift).
cases.clerk_margin_notes: Water is life down here. Even though Boris was clean and apologetic, Dmitri made it clear that tampering with the artesian valve risks our lives.

cases.charge_summary: Discrepancy of two 1ml morphine ampoules from the Emergency Surgical Cabinet following a blast survivor amputation.
cases.evidence_presented: Broken glass tip found behind the autoclave; audit log signed by Dr. Vel showing ampoules were accidentally dropped and crushed during a tremor.
cases.verdict_outcome: Full Exoneration / Administrative Error
cases.disciplinary_penalty: No penalty. Cabinet lock upgraded to dual-key requirement (Dr. Vel & Sister Mara).
cases.clerk_margin_notes: Tense trial that tested the trust of the entire medical staff. Dr. Vel took full responsibility for the broken ampoules and audited the remaining stock.

cases.charge_summary: Entering the refrigerated heirloom seed vault without authorization to photograph the 1938 Vavilov wheat packet labels for the historical archive.
cases.evidence_presented: One pre-war FED rangefinder camera, four glass plates, and temperature spike of 1.2°C in the seed chiller.
cases.verdict_outcome: Guilty of Biosphere Protocol Violation / Commended for Historical Dedication
cases.disciplinary_penalty: Camera confiscated for two weeks. Defendant assigned to assist Elena with daily seed germination humidity logs under direct supervision.
cases.clerk_margin_notes: Galina argued that 'saving the seed means nothing if our grandchildren don't know who bred the grain.' Elena agreed and offered her a job.

cases.charge_summary: Operating an illicit high-stakes poker den behind Boiler #2 using hand-painted cardboard cards and wagering ammunition primer caps.
cases.evidence_presented: 52 greasy cards drawn on electrical schematic backing, 140 brass primer caps, three packs of pre-war cigarettes, and one pot of turnip moonshine.
cases.verdict_outcome: Guilty of Dangerous Material Wagering
cases.disciplinary_penalty: Cards burned in the boiler. Primer caps returned to the armory. Defendants assigned to stack 50 tons of coal in Adit 1.
cases.clerk_margin_notes: Oleg noted that the Jack of Spades bore a striking, uncomplimentary resemblance to Dmitri. Sister Mara warned them about gambling away ammunition.

cases.charge_summary: Growing unauthorized black oyster mushrooms on moist jute sacks behind the steam condensate return pipes.
cases.evidence_presented: Six burlap sacks bursting with prime grey oyster mushrooms, one watering can, and a four-degree temperature drop in the condensate pipe.
cases.verdict_outcome: Guilty of Unauthorized Cultivation / Absorbed into Official Kitchen Supply
cases.disciplinary_penalty: Nadia designated Assistant Fungal Agronomist. 50% of harvest diverted to communal canteen; 50% retained by defendant.
cases.clerk_margin_notes: Elena was astonished by the growth rate: 'The steam pipe heat was ideal. She accidentally discovered a more efficient fruiting method than my greenhouse.'

cases.charge_summary: Physical brawl in Cubicle 14 over who gets the lower bunk bed away from the drafty air ventilation louver.
cases.evidence_presented: One torn wool blanket, one bent aluminum bed frame strut, and two black eyes.
cases.verdict_outcome: Mutual Fault / Mediated Reconciliation
cases.disciplinary_penalty: Defendants ordered to weld a warm baffle plate over the air duct together, then trade bunks every month on the full moon.
cases.clerk_margin_notes: Sister Mara made them shake hands and drink a cup of hot willow tea together. By evening, they were laughing and playing dominoes.

cases.presiding_magistrate: Dr. Irina Vel & Chief Engineer Dmitri
cases.charge_summary: Adjusting the calibration potentiometer on a DP-5V survey meter with a screwdriver to make background readings appear 'safe' so his crew could finish mining early.
cases.evidence_presented: One DP-5V survey meter reading 0.05 mR/h in a 1.2 R/h radon zone, one pocket screwdriver, and signed statements from three panicked miners.
cases.verdict_outcome: Guilty of Reckless Endangerment (Severe Tier 4 Infraction)
cases.disciplinary_penalty: Suspended from all technical work for sixty days. Sentenced to wash contaminated rubber hazmat boots in the airlock decontamination sump.
cases.clerk_margin_notes: Dr. Vel was white with fury: 'Lying to an instrument is lying to death itself. You almost killed three men to go to bed twenty minutes early.'

cases.charge_summary: Theft of eighteen wrapped pre-war Domino sugar cubes from the high-shelf emergency pantry cache.
cases.evidence_presented: Sticky fingerprints on the pantry lockbox, six empty paper wrappers found behind the library encyclopedias, and wide guilty eyes.
cases.verdict_outcome: Guilty with Childhood Leniency
cases.disciplinary_penalty: Defendants assigned to pick stones and chaff out of 50 kilos of raw rye grain for the bakery before afternoon school.
cases.clerk_margin_notes: Oxana slipped two remaining sugar cubes into Sonya's pocket after the verdict, whispering: 'Don't let your grandmother see.'

cases.charge_summary: Breaching quarantine protocol by bringing a living yellow dandelion growing in a cracked asphalt seam back into the bunker without autoclave sterilization.
cases.evidence_presented: One living yellow dandelion rooted in a crushed tin can of surface soil, measuring 0.02 mR/h gamma background.
cases.verdict_outcome: Quarantine Violation / Transferred to Bio-Containment
cases.disciplinary_penalty: Harlan given a formal administrative reprimand. Dandelion placed in isolated glass jar in Dr. Vel's laboratory window.
cases.clerk_margin_notes: Harlan said: 'I have walked through ash for eight hundred days. I needed to see something that didn't know the world had ended.' Nobody voted to destroy it.

cases.charge_summary: Patching a recording of rooster crowing and barnyard animal sounds into the bunker general emergency alert system at 05:00 on April Fool's Day.
cases.evidence_presented: One magnetic tape loop, two audio patch cords plugged into Central PA Console, and eighty dwellers bolting upright in panic.
cases.verdict_outcome: Guilty of False Alarm Disorder
cases.disciplinary_penalty: Defendants ordered to manually clean and oil all 24 brass intercom horn grilles across the entire bunker complex.
cases.clerk_margin_notes: Dmitri confessed he reached for his service pistol thinking a mutated turkey had breached Airlock 1. The fine was paid in tobacco.

cases.presiding_magistrate: Dr. Irina Vel, Harlan & Sister Mara
cases.charge_summary: Attempting to trade expired, diluted tetracycline capsules to bunker dwellers in exchange for precision lathe drill bits.
cases.evidence_presented: Twenty capsules filled with flour and crushed aspirin; chemical reagent test conducted by Dr. Vel demonstrating 0% active antibiotic.
cases.verdict_outcome: Guilty of Fraudulent Medical Endangerment (Class S Crime)
cases.disciplinary_penalty: All goods confiscated. Defendant permanently expelled from the shelter perimeter and blacklisted from all regional trade protocols.
cases.clerk_margin_notes: Dr. Vel declared: 'Those who counterfeit medicine in an atomic winter are murderers who have not yet fired their rifles.' Unanimous verdict.

cases.charge_summary: Siphoning 500ml of concentrated sulfuric acid from the main substation backup bank to conduct amateur electroplating experiments on copper spoons.
cases.evidence_presented: Three beautifully gold-plated zinc spoons, one glass beaker with acid residue, and cell #14 specific gravity dropping to 1.180 g/cm3.
cases.verdict_outcome: Guilty of Critical Power Sabotage / Technical Commendation
cases.disciplinary_penalty: Defendant ordered to re-acidify and equalize all 60 battery cells with new electrolyte, then plate the Council's tea set for free.
cases.clerk_margin_notes: Dmitri was impressed by the plating adhesion: 'The spoons look pre-war. But if you touch cell #14 again, I will electroplate your nose.'

cases.charge_summary: Drinking the ceremonial bottle of 1978 Stolichnaya vodka reserved for memorial eulogies after a tense 36-hour radioactive dust storm.
cases.evidence_presented: One empty green glass bottle hidden in the snowplow toolbox, breath alcohol test positive on both sentries.
cases.verdict_outcome: Guilty of Sacrilege and Shift Neglect
cases.disciplinary_penalty: Defendants ordered to dig three emergency storage vaults in the frozen gravel adit without gloves (shovels provided).
cases.clerk_margin_notes: Sister Mara made them light three candles at Sister Mara's memorial crypt and recite the names of the 31 fallen from the triage log.

cases.charge_summary: Installing illegal copper bypass valves on the heating riser to redirect 80% of residential steam heat into the workshop break room.
cases.evidence_presented: A toasty 28°C in the workshop break room while Residential Block B dropped to a shivering 9°C; custom copper solder joints.
cases.verdict_outcome: Guilty of Thermal Theft
cases.disciplinary_penalty: Apprentices sentenced to haul anthracite coal from the deep seam to the boiler hoppers for twenty-one days.
cases.clerk_margin_notes: Nadia personally supervised their coal hauling shifts: 'If you want extra steam, you can shovel the black rocks that make it.'

cases.charge_summary: Broadcasting an unauthorized reading of pre-war humanitarian poetry and the 'Charter of Living Men' across the continent on 104.7 MHz without military clearance.
cases.evidence_presented: Tape recorder master reel, intercepted carrier wave acknowledgment from a distant survivor bunker in the Ural Mountains.
cases.verdict_outcome: Acquitted by Unanimous Council Acclamation / Adopted as Official Foreign Policy
cases.disciplinary_penalty: No penalty. The Council formally ratified the broadcast text as the Tessarat Free Shelter Declaration.
cases.clerk_margin_notes: When the signal from the Ural bunker crackled back through the static saying 'We hear you, brothers. We are alive too,' Dr. Vel openly wept.

cases.defendant_name: The People of Tessarat Valley (120 Dwellers & Outpost Delegates)
cases.presiding_magistrate: Dr. Sonya Vel, Master Oleg & Sister Mara
cases.charge_summary: Petition to dissolve wartime emergency military tribunals and establish a permanent democratic constitution for the post-ash civil society on Day 3650.
cases.evidence_presented: The Living Century Seed Apple Tree in bloom, the 16 Faction Treaty Protocols, and 120 signed ballots cast into the bronze ballot urn.
cases.verdict_outcome: Constitution Ratified Unanimously / Wartime Martial Decrees Dissolved Forever
cases.disciplinary_penalty: All previous civil trial fines and chore penalties permanently expunged from the Standing Record. Universal amnesty declared.
cases.clerk_margin_notes: Sister Mara closed the black docket book for the final time and laid down her pen. Master Oleg struck the brass anvil three times. The war is over. The republic begins.
